name: Borescope Inspection
description: A borescope is a thin flexible camera that can be inserted into door gaps, under doors, through small openings, or into ceiling tile gaps to inspect spaces that are otherwise inaccessible. During recon, this tool reveals what lies on the other side of a door — whether a latch is exposed, whether a lever handle is present, or whether a REX sensor is positioned in a reachable location. It is also useful for inspecting the interior of access control enclosures.

blue.det: Thin flexible cable visible at door gap during extended use; time at door without key; camera coverage of entry point.
blue.cm: Door gap reduction via weatherstripping and proper thresholds; camera coverage of entry points from multiple angles; motion sensors on interior side of controlled doors.
